policies.title: UAE ordinary passports: current visa-free short visits
policies.summary: UAE MOFA's live country pages expressly classify Normal UAE passports as Visa Free for these destinations.
conditions: Each source is a current UAE-MOFA destination page for Emirati travellers and specifically identifies the Normal passport row.
The listed outcome is for ordinary short travel; work, residence, special passports, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: UAE ordinary passports: current visitor visas on arrival
policies.summary: UAE MOFA's live country pages expressly classify Normal UAE passports as Visa On Arrival for these destinations.
conditions: Each source is a current UAE-MOFA destination page for Emirati travellers and specifically identifies the Normal passport row.
The sources expressly place issuance at arrival; entry point, fees, passport validity, security, work, residence, special passports, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

unresolved.reason: UAE MOFA marks Normal passports visa-required but simultaneously says UAE citizens are not allowed to travel except diplomatic, emergency-treatment and pre-authorized delegation cases. It therefore does not establish an ordinary short-visitor baseline, and the taxonomy has no unavailable route.

No retrievable current UAE-MOFA or Ivorian authority source establishes ordinary UAE-passport visitor treatment and actual issuance timing. Côte d'Ivoire online pre-enrolment is not treated as a nationality eligibility schedule.

No retrievable current UAE-MOFA or Iraqi authority source establishes ordinary UAE-passport visitor treatment and actual issuance timing. An electronic-visa portal alone is not treated as pair-specific eligibility.

No retrievable current UAE or Palestinian authority source establishes an ETA for an ordinary UAE visitor to the Palestinian Territories. Israeli crossing, permit and operational-access controls are not normalized as a Palestinian ETA.

Liberia's arrival route is conditional on prior immigration approval or absence-of-mission handling. UAE MOFA's one-word arrival label does not establish an unconditional ordinary UAE-passport visitor baseline.
